# The Resident Bookkeeper

The Resident Bookkeeper (THERESIDENTBOOKKEEPER LTD, RC 9906291) is a remote bookkeeping company based in Abuja, Nigeria, serving small and growing businesses in Nigeria, the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia and Canada.

Tagline: Accurate Records. Smarter Decisions. Stronger Business.

## What we do
- Record every sale and expense each month
- Match bank statements so nothing is missing (bank reconciliation)
- A clear monthly report of profit and cash, which is the figure a business's tax is based on
- Payroll support: staff salaries tracked and PAYE calculated (Nigeria)
- VAT and withholding tax (WHT) tracked as you go, so nothing comes as a surprise (Nigeria; VAT, GST, GST/HST or sales-tax-coded records in other markets)
- Catch-up and clean-up: old, messy records brought up to date before they become a tax problem
- Accounts payable and receivable support, and monthly or annual financial reports

We keep books tax-ready. We do not give tax or legal advice, file tax returns, audit, or move client funds; we prepare the records that make filing accurate.

Every new client starts with a free Books Health Check to confirm scope before any price is agreed.

## Pricing (local currency; final price confirmed in writing after the free Books Health Check)
Plan limits: Essentials up to 150 transactions a month and 2 bank or card accounts; Growth up to 400 and 5; Premium up to 800 and 10; above that is a custom quote.

Nigeria (NGN):
- TRB Books Lite: ₦100,000 a year (up to 2 business bank accounts and 100 transactions a month; statement upload, categorisation, reconciliation and monthly reports)
- Essentials ₦150,000 a month; Growth ₦300,000 a month; Premium ₦550,000 a month
- Catch-up ₦100,000 per month of records; Clean-up from ₦250,000

United States (USD): Essentials $299, Growth $499, Premium $849 a month; Catch-up $199 per month of records; Clean-up from $499
United Kingdom (GBP): Essentials £229, Growth £399, Premium £679 a month; Catch-up £159 per month; Clean-up from £399
Canada (CAD): Essentials C$399, Growth C$679, Premium C$1,149 a month; Catch-up C$269 per month; Clean-up from C$679
Australia (AUD): Essentials A$449, Growth A$749, Premium A$1,279 a month; Catch-up A$299 per month; Clean-up from A$749
